status: baseline on the iOS-native redesign (MAZ-132); visual comparison against implementations remains MAZ-122

decisions.decision: docs/design/penny-ios and design-kit replace the Penpot proposal (docs/design/penny-redesign, removed in #30).

Light and dark only, following the system setting. Dark is true black, so AMOLED is dropped; Catppuccin is dropped and not kept as an accent. A saved legacy amoled or catppuccin preference migrates to dark (MAZ-72/87).
iPhone tabs Home, Activity, Shared and Trips with a separate add button; More is replaced by a Settings sheet. Every legacy route keeps a destination (navigation.legacyRoutes).
iOS uses SF Pro with Dynamic Type and SF Symbols. Web uses Inter (bundled with its OFL license) and Ionicons v7 outline (MIT).
No Android card; the legacy Android app is retired under MAZ-98 and has no redesign baseline.
